# sink_drape — realism QA repair

Long and short ends over sink divider, hem and terry surface; long-end orientation corrected.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f0168, f0008, f0194. Mean silhouette IoU 0.6557. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/sink_drape_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/sink_drape/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=C, proportions=C, colour_texture=C, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Corrected reversed orientation of the long hanging end.
- Shortened the opposite hanging end and reduced exaggerated wrinkles.
- Replaced thick slabs with thin cloth contact patches and tentative shell properties.

## Remaining

- Detailed fold/edge shape still differs in the registered views.
- No runtime cloth dynamics or measured wet mass.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.

Mean IoU 0.6557 -> 0.9006; same-mask RGB distance 0.4119.

- Preserved colour transforms, glass IOR/optical thickness/absorption and metal anisotropy in portable GLB material extensions; procedural bump/SSS remain renderer-dependent.
- Re-measured source depth with ktools in all three review frames; retained depth/calibration uncertainty.
- Replaced unexplained mass priors with explicit constituent volume × density or textile-area budgets; synchronized part masses and COM metadata.
- Added portable MJCF rigid contacts and checked all convex collision meshes.
- Reconstructed the asymmetric hanging silhouette from three calibrated source contours, constrained by the prior rest shape.
- Re-baked large-scale cloth colour from the three original photos onto vertex colours, with validity masks and directional view weights; retained terry microdetail.
- Added thin convex surface contacts and a membrane FEM force-response scene.

Remaining:

- Hidden fold topology is inferred; rest envelope and actual cloth sheet topology are not equivalent.
- Mass, friction, restitution and stiffness remain estimates, not measured physical calibration.
- Coarse FEM scene is separate from the detailed GLB; dynamic skinning, bending/tearing and real constitutive calibration remain incomplete.

See model.json physics.mass_budget, simulation/rigid.xml, and (for soft assets) simulation/deformable.xml. Generated microtextures are inferred detail, never source evidence.
